pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit complex polygonal and star-like geometries with jagged, high-frequency edge serrations. Patch size decreases in spatial area from the neck region toward the lower flank and abdomen.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Lighter-colored pathways form a continuous reticulated network with relatively uniform pixel thickness across the torso. Topological nodes are predominantly characterized by three-way intersections (tri-junctions).

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents as a continuous, short-cropped vertical fringe with a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder transition.
